jobs.title: TypeScript Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Kuku FM has an open TypeScript Full Stack Developer Intern position in Thiruvananthapuram for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live type-safe full-stack development projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews.

About the role
As a TypeScript Full Stack Developer Intern at Kuku FM, your core focus will be building typed end-to-end features where the API contract is enforced by the compiler. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on building typed end-to-end features where the API contract is enforced by the compiler alongside the core team
• Use TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, REST & tRPC / GraphQL, PostgreSQL on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, REST & tRPC / GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Prisma / TypeORM, Jest & Testing, Git & GitHub, ESLint & Code Quality, CI Pipelines — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT), BCA, MCA or M.Sc (Computer Science) based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram. You should be willing to learn TypeScript, Node.js, React.js and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 6-month internship in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with a stipend of ₹22,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a typed API and client feature that shipped together. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

Expect to leave with real project experience, exposure to professional tooling and process, and mentorship that helps you plan a concrete next step in your career. Outstanding interns can convert to a full-time offer at the end of the internship.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT), BCA, MCA or M.Sc (Computer Science)
• Graduating batch: 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, REST & tRPC / GraphQL, PostgreSQL
• Also useful: Prisma / TypeORM, Jest & Testing, Git & GitHub, ESLint & Code Quality, CI Pipelines
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 4-6 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours worked remotely, with a fixed daily stand-up
• Duration: 6 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: you will need your own laptop and a stable internet connection; software licences and tool access are provided by the company
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: Kuku FM and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Kuku FM's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early.
